Mechanics of Materials in Architectural Engineering 1
Korean Modern and Contemporary City and Housing
Mechanical and Electrical Systems for Building
The City Cultures and Urban Conservation

requirements: 1. Credits Required for Graduation : 160 credits (40required general education credits | 110 major credits (102 required major credits))

2. Mandatory Foreign Language Courses (College of Engineering Regulation) - Students must complete at least three courses taught in a foreign language, which must include at least one major course. - College English is excluded from this count
3. Internship Program: Students who have completed at least their second year (4 semesters) must participate in a field practicum/internship for a minimum of 4 weeks prior to graduation.
4. Architecture Exhibition: Students must participate in the architecture exhibition their graduation project.
5. Graduation Design Thesis: Students must submit a graduation design thesis.
6. Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education: Students must complete this mandatory education program.
7. Safety and Environment Education : Students must complete 2 hours of mandatory education as freshmen, and 6 hours of regular education every subsequent semester.

requirements: 1. Credits Required for Graduation: 130 credits (40 required general education credits | 73 major credits (60 required major credits))

2. Mandatory Foreign Language Courses (College of Engineering Regulation) - Students must complete at least three courses taught in a foreign language, which must include at least one major course. - College English is excluded from this count
3. Internship Program: Students who have completed at least their second year (4 semesters) must participate in a field practicum/internship for a minimum of 4 weeks prior to graduation.

4. Architecture Exhibition: Students must participate in the architecture exhibition their graduation project. - When enrolling in Capstone Design in Architectural Engineering, students must concurrently take at least one of the following courses: Architectural Environmental Design, Structural Design, or Smart Construction Technology.
5. Graduation Thesis: Students must submit a graduation thesis.

6. ABEEK (Accreditation Board for Engineering Education of Korea) Certification: - Fulfillment of all accreditation criteria - New TEPS score of 327 or higher - Student portfolio submission - Graduation interview - Graduation survey - Minimum grade of C- in all individual required major courses - Overall GPA of C+ or higher in all major courses
7. Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education: Students must complete this mandatory education program.
8. Safety and Environment Education : Students must complete 2 hours of mandatory education as freshmen, and 6 hours of regular education every subsequent semester.
